metadata.operating_point: Original t=4s scan command held constant. Original spatial material map unchanged and static; no scan, breathing, activation, external load or ripple. Memory starts exactly relaxed. Small lateral excursions and K modulation measured.
metadata.H: Calibrated once per condition by original update_phase on noise-free no-H20.8Hz data, then held fixed for all frequencies/interventions; no precision gate in this diagnostic calibration. H increment default; no gates or memory filters.
metadata.phase: output relative to input; scalar k_hat has no phase. weighted_Z_over_Y phase is supplied separately, not assigned to scalar k_hat.
metadata.interventions: Physical fast pole only, keeping total tau_a fixed; ForceSensing retains nominal2ms and original calibration. mass0 removes true and compensated tool mass; offset0 removes true and calibrated offset. kr_large=1e12.
metadata.L1: col21/22 always20.8Hz. Reevaluate original constitutive/series formula at every drive frequency as a separate field.
metadata.L7: Three explicit channels: command to raw sensed force, ForceSensing-compensated force consumed by Method, and true axial force. Command is the held sequence supplied to plant.

images.note: Derived 1D arm alternatives at the same measured encoder harmonics, not a changed-plant simulation. Continuous scalar sums omit geometry/support/discretization; discrete_1d adds implemented Prony, acceleration differences, and body support, but omits lateral coupling/spatial gradients. Its measured quasi closure bounds that residual before interpreting the mass-spring alternative.
